# EduCore — Offline School Management Software & ERP for Windows

> EduCore is an enterprise-grade, 100% offline-first Windows desktop School Management & ERP System developed by Sublime Enterprises. It operates fully on-premise without cloud dependencies, securing all institutional records inside local encrypted SQLite databases with zero recurring monthly student fees.

## Core Capabilities & Modules
- Student Information Dossier: Comprehensive admissions, Excel bulk import, promotion wizard, and student ledgers.
- Dual-Track Attendance: Daily student and faculty registers, chronic absentee tracking, formatted register printing.
- Automated Fee Management: 1-Click batch fee generation for 1,000+ students in <1s, thermal and A4 laser receipts, concessions.
- Staff HR & Payroll: Roster management, attendance-linked salary deductions, watermarked PDF salary slips.
- Examinations & Marksheets: Board grading scales, consolidated report card PDFs, rank calculations, and admit cards.
- Timetable & Calendar: Conflict-free period scheduling and academic event calendar.
- Digital Library: ISBN book cataloging, circulation checkouts/returns, overdue fine tracking.
- Certificates & Identity Cards: 1-Click Bonafide, Transfer (TC), Character certificates, and QR-verified ID cards.
- Automated Backup Engine: Daily background snapshots with SQLite PRAGMA integrity verification and 30-day rotation.

## System Requirements
- Operating System: Microsoft Windows 10 & Windows 11 (64-bit)
- Hardware: Minimum 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended), 500 MB disk space
- Architecture: 100% On-premise native desktop executable with embedded SQLite database
